title: Tritium Lib
description: A library contaning utilities for rendering, easing, and tick scheduling
body:
Adds utility classes for:
- Rendering: Classes to render textured quads and cubes
- Tick Scheduling: Utils to run code after/for a set amount of ticks
- Easing: A TON of easing functions with example usages in the same class
- Math: Vector rotation, packet buffer read/write methods

[Visit the full wiki on GitHub!](https://github.com/Homak-Homak/tritium-lib-1.20.1/wiki)

This mod does nothing if installed by itself
